tools.name: acad_create_blank_test_document
tools.description:
Create a new unsaved blank drawing for isolated CadGPT testing.

This low-level tool is consumed by the outer `drawing_create_test` tool
and is not intended to be exposed directly to ChatGPT.

tools.name: acad_get_active_document
tools.description: Return AutoCAD's currently active drawing. Discovery only; not CadGPT binding.

tools.name: acad_list_open_documents
tools.description: List all open AutoCAD drawings and mark AutoCAD's current active tab. Read-only.

tools.name: acad_set_active_document
tools.description: Activate an open drawing and optionally require its lifetime runtime ID.

tools.name: cad_copy_entities
tools.description: Copy explicit entities and return the newly created handles.

tools.name: cad_create_layer
tools.description: Create a named layer in the bound drawing. Does not create geometry.

tools.name: cad_ensure_drawing_anchor
tools.description:
Ensure the canonical CadGPT Drawing Anchor exists on one explicitly identified AutoCAD document and return it.

This low-level primitive stores schema_version + drawing_anchor in the
Named Objects Dictionary extension dictionary as
CADGPT_DRAWING_ANCHOR XRecord. Existing valid anchors are never
replaced.

tools.name: cad_execute_delete_preview
tools.description:
Delete the exact entity snapshot represented by a one-shot preview token.

The token expires, is tied to the previewed drawing, and is consumed
before deletion starts. If execution is uncertain or interrupted, do not
retry the same token; preview again and verify current drawing state.

tools.name: cad_get_block
tools.description: Get one block reference by handle, including attribute values.

tools.name: cad_get_current_layer
tools.description: Return the current layer of the CadGPT-bound drawing. Read-only.

tools.name: cad_get_entity
tools.description: Get one supported entity by AutoCAD handle from the bound drawing.

tools.name: cad_host_status
tools.description: Return AutoCAD host/version/document diagnostics. Read-only.

tools.name: cad_inventory_layer_objects
tools.description:
Return structured entity counts grouped by layer and AutoCAD object type.

Use this instead of visual inspection for cleanup/mapping decisions when
layer/object evidence is sufficient. The CadGPT proxy enforces the bound
drawing before this call.

tools.name: cad_list_block_definitions
tools.description: List named block definitions and attribute definitions. Read-only.

tools.name: cad_list_blocks
tools.description:
List block references in the CadGPT-bound drawing. Read-only.

Optional filter fields: layer, handle and limit. The tool is always
restricted to block references regardless of any supplied type filter.

tools.name: cad_list_entities
tools.description: List supported entities in the CadGPT-bound drawing. Read-only.

tools.name: cad_list_layers
tools.description: List layers and basic state for the CadGPT-bound drawing. Read-only.

tools.name: cad_load_lisp_file
tools.description:
Load and verify one sandboxed `.lsp` file.

Accepted inputs are the CadGPT virtual Lisp namespaces or canonical
absolute paths that resolve inside those same approved roots:
`resources/cad/**`, `appdata/libraries/lisp/**`,
`appdata/workspace/lisp-draft/**`, and
`appdata/runtime/dynamic-lisp/**`. External user source folders and
absolute paths outside those roots are rejected.

The tool waits for an AutoCAD load sentinel and returns `loaded`, error
evidence, and command-log tail when available. `loaded: false` blocks
command execution and must be debugged before handoff.

tools.name: cad_mirror_entities
tools.description: Mirror explicit entities while always preserving source entities.

tools.name: cad_move_entities
tools.description: Move existing entities by a displacement vector. No new geometry is created.

tools.name: cad_observation_capture_cancel
tools.description: Stop capture and discard collected handles without finalization.

tools.name: cad_observation_capture_finish
tools.description:
Stop capture and return surviving top-level candidate headers.

Finalization resolves only handles observed since capture start, drops
erased/undone/nested/block-definition objects, and returns identity +
object type. It never performs a full-drawing scan.

tools.name: cad_observation_capture_start
tools.description:
Start lightweight ObjectAdded capture on the bound drawing.

The capture phase stores only handles for newly appended drawing
objects. It does not enumerate the drawing or read full properties.

tools.name: cad_observation_capture_status
tools.description: Return lightweight status for the current Observation capture.

tools.name: cad_preview_delete_entities
tools.description:
Preview a non-empty entity filter and return a short-lived delete token.

This tool never deletes geometry. The returned token captures the exact
handle snapshot and drawing identity. Inspect the preview before calling
cad_execute_delete_preview.

tools.name: cad_read_entity_properties
tools.description:
Read all discoverable direct properties for one or many entities.

This tool is read-only and entity-generic. It does not traverse block
definitions, nested entities, or child COM objects.

tools.name: cad_rename_layer
tools.description: Rename a layer without changing entity geometry.

tools.name: cad_rotate_entities
tools.description: Rotate existing entities around a base point; angle is radians.

tools.name: cad_run_lisp_command
tools.description:
Queue a named AutoLISP/AutoCAD command on the CadGPT-bound drawing.

This is intentionally not a raw command-string tool. Command names are
restricted to identifier characters and arguments to scalar strings or
numbers. Use only after `cad_load_lisp_file` reports `loaded: true`.
Interactive Lisp commands should normally be handed to the user after a
verified load instead of inventing prompt input. Automated commands must
be verified with structured CAD postconditions.

tools.name: cad_scale_entities
tools.description: Scale existing entities about a base point by a positive factor.

tools.name: cad_set_current_layer
tools.description: Set the current layer of the bound drawing. Reversible state change.

tools.name: cad_set_entity_color
tools.description: Set entity color by ACI; 0=ByBlock, 256=ByLayer.

tools.name: cad_set_entity_layer
tools.description: Move specific entities to an existing layer by handle.

tools.name: cad_set_entity_linetype
tools.description: Set entity linetype to ByLayer/ByBlock or a loaded linetype.

tools.name: cad_set_entity_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide specific entities without deleting them.

tools.name: cad_set_layer_color
tools.description: Set a layer AutoCAD Color Index (1-255).

tools.name: cad_set_layer_freeze
tools.description: Freeze or thaw a layer in the bound drawing.

tools.name: cad_set_layer_lock
tools.description: Lock or unlock a layer in the bound drawing.

tools.name: cad_set_layer_on
tools.description: Turn a layer on or off in the bound drawing.

tools.name: cad_update_arc
tools.description: Update Arc center/radius/angles by handle. Angles are radians.

tools.name: cad_update_line
tools.description: Update Line endpoints by handle. At least one endpoint is required.
